manual_checklist.title: Enter via a Travellers' Point of Entry
manual_checklist.detail: Pets arriving directly into Northern Ireland from a third country must enter through an authorised Travellers' Point of Entry for the EU documentary and identity checks.
scope_notes: Applies for arrival via: Northern Ireland

manual_checklist.title: Give DAERA advance notification
manual_checklist.detail: Notify the authorities in advance of arrival (air arrivals must contact the relevant office ahead of travel). Confirm the current notice period with DAERA before booking.
scope_notes: Applies for arrival via: Northern Ireland

manual_checklist.title: DAERA documentary and identity checks
manual_checklist.detail: Documentary and identity checks are carried out on the non-commercial movement of pets entering NI; present the pet, microchip, and the EU Animal Health Certificate.
scope_notes: Applies for arrival via: Northern Ireland

manual_checklist.title: Travel within 5 days of your pet
manual_checklist.detail: For non-commercial movement the owner (or an authorised person) must travel within 5 days of the pet. Outside that window it is treated as a commercial import.
scope_notes: Applies for arrival via: Northern Ireland

manual_checklist.title: Maximum 5 pets (non-commercial)
manual_checklist.detail: Up to 5 pets may move for non-commercial purposes in a single movement; more needs the commercial route.
scope_notes: Applies for arrival via: Northern Ireland

manual_checklist.title: Apply for the Northern Ireland Pet Travel Document (PTD)
manual_checklist.detail: Residents of Great Britain need a free, lifetime Northern Ireland Pet Travel Document to bring a pet from GB into NI. Apply online via GOV.UK (APHA). The PTD and the pet's microchip are checked at the port or airport.

manual_checklist.title: Sign the declaration of no onward EU travel
manual_checklist.detail: The PTD includes a declaration that you will not travel onward with the pet to Ireland or another EU country. If you intend onward EU travel you need an EU Animal Health Certificate instead (see below).

manual_checklist.title: Northern Ireland resident: microchip only
manual_checklist.detail: If you live in Northern Ireland you do not need a Pet Travel Document to bring your pet from GB to NI — just make sure it is microchipped.

manual_checklist.title: Two-stage movement via Great Britain
manual_checklist.detail: Entering via Great Britain is a two-stage movement: the pet must first be imported INTO Great Britain under the GB rules (the GB pet health certificate, APHIS-endorsed), and then moved GB->NI. Petra evaluates the GB->NI leg here; complete the GB import separately as its own trip.
scope_notes: Applies for arrival via: United Kingdom
